newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bodies of two German tourists found in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Bodies of two German tourists found in Turkey.

text.p: The bodies of two German tourists were found near the Turkish Mediterranean tourist resort of Antalya on Thursday, a spokesman for the German embassy told Reuters.
Anatolian news agency said an autopsy had found that the man and the woman bore marks of heavy blows to the head and had been dead for two days.
The deceased were named by Anatolian as Christoph Gerald, 36, and Heike Angela Gutsmann, 30. Police said personal belongings and money were found with the bodies.
